name: Anodizing Chillers
title: Anodizing Chiller Manufacturer, Coimbatore | Electroplating Bath Cooling
description: Chillers for anodizing and electroplating bath cooling, engineered to order by Win Equipments, Coimbatore. Share your bath chemistry and heat load for sizing.
card: Bath chillers engineered to order for anodizing and electroplating lines.
lede: Anodizing and electroplating baths heat up as current passes through the electrolyte, and the bath must be held within its process temperature window. Win Equipments builds bath chillers to order, with wetted materials chosen for your chemistry.
needs: Process type (anodizing, hard anodizing, electroplating) and bath chemistry
Bath volume and required bath temperature
Rectifier rating (A and V) or measured heat load
Cooling method: immersion coil or external heat exchanger
Available power supply and plant ambient temperature

faqs.q: Why is there no standard model table?
faqs.a: These units are engineered to order around your duty, so we size and quote each one from your requirement rather than publishing a fixed model list. Send your requirement and our engineers will reply with a recommended configuration.
